messages: maria: Quick design review for API Keys UX. Dropping problems and ideas before the meeting. maria: Problems: (1) Empty state doesn't guide scope selection. (2) Rotate modal disconnects from list context. (3) Revoke is scary with no easy recovery. teo: Suggestion: show a 'Create from template' example row in the empty state: one-click create with recommended scope (e.g., 'embeddings - read only'). evam: For rotate, change heading to 'Rotate key (creates a new secret)' and show the new secret inline in a dismissible top banner so it's clear it's short-lived. sam: Revoke flow: propose 'Disable (recoverable for 24h)' as a second option next to hard revoke. Add help text: 'Disabled keys can be re-enabled within 24 hours.' aria: Accessibility checklist: aria-live for secret reveal and list updates, labels for scope radio group, visible focus ring on rows, return focus to row after inline drawer closes. maria: Layout: prefer an inline right-hand drawer for revoke/rotate details instead of full modal on long lists. Keep keyboard trap and focus return. teo: Empty state should include three CTAs: Quickstart snippet, Create sample key (primary), Read permissions docs. design-bot: Snippet for create-from-template button: Creates a key scoped to embeddings (read only). evam: Analytics events to add: key_create_start, key_create_from_template, key_rotate_confirm, key_revoke_disable, key_revoke_hard. sam: Owners: @teo will prototype empty state + template card, @evan will prototype inline rotate banner, @sam will mock disable drawer, @aria will run the a11y pass. maria: I'll open tracker tickets: PROD-keys-template-empty, PROD-keys-rotate-inline, PROD-keys-disable-drawer, PROD-keys-a11y. Post any microcopy tweaks here. teo: tiny copy change: prefer 'Disable' over 'Soft revoke'. maria: Thanks everyone, will sync on Tuesday with wireframes.
